# Yabloko Labs

> Yabloko Labs is a UK-based technology company founded in 2025 that builds production AI Agents, hybrid quantum-AI software, open-source MCP servers, and related business automation.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://yablokolabs.com/): Company overview, products, open-source MCP servers, and research.
- [About](https://yablokolabs.com/#about): Company background, mission, and values.
- [AI Agents](https://yablokolabs.com/ai-agents): Custom AI Agents designed, deployed, and operated for business workflows, including the Agent Intelligence Platform for conversational analytics, observability, and self-diagnostics.
- [Blog](https://yablokolabs.com/blog): Technical notes about production AI Agent engineering and operations.
- [Gender Equality Plan](https://yablokolabs.com/gender-equality-plan): The company's published Gender Equality Plan.
- [Contact](https://yablokolabs.com/#contact): Public support and consultation contact information.

## Products

- [Q-Router](https://router.yablokolabs.com): Quantum-enhanced delivery route optimization with AI traffic prediction.
- [Q-AdMix](https://admix.yablokolabs.com): Hybrid quantum-classical AI for ad spend optimization.
- [Q-Porter](https://porter.yablokolabs.com): Hybrid quantum-classical AI for port and airport logistics optimization.
- [Q-Consent](https://consent.yablokolabs.com): Quantum-AI consent and compliance management software.

## Open source

- [Jñāpakam](https://mcpize.com/mcp/jnaapakam): An MCP server providing persistent long-term memory for AI agents.
- [TruthLens](https://mcpize.com/mcp/truthlens): An MCP server for local trust scoring and hallucination-risk analysis of LLM outputs.
- [NexaCore](https://mcpize.com/mcp/nexa-core): An MCP runtime for high-dimensional holographic hypervector computing.
- [AI Consent](https://mcpize.com/mcp/ai-consent): An MCP server for automated EU AI Act compliance classification and remediation planning for AI agents.
- [CallLens](https://mcpize.com/mcp/calllens): An MCP server for automated conversation quality assurance using behavioral rubrics and LangGraph-powered evaluation.

## Research

- [AI governance and standards research](https://yablokolabs.com/ai-agents#governance): The AI Agents page summarizes the standards used in engineering and links to published research.
- [Trustworthy AI Standardisation for Financial Services](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21603770): A published assessment of gaps in AI standards for financial services and a Continuous Reliability Assurance proposal.

## Blog articles

- [SearXNG: Independent Meta-Search for Agent-Ready Discovery](https://yablokolabs.com/blog/searxng-independent-discovery): A practical guide to independent discovery and verification for AI agents.
- [Hermes Provider Fallbacks](https://yablokolabs.com/blog/hermes-provider-fallbacks): A guide to designing provider fallback chains for production AI agents.

## Common questions

- What does Yabloko Labs do? It designs, deploys, and operates custom AI agents and hybrid quantum-AI software for businesses.
- Where is Yabloko Labs based? London, United Kingdom, with remote delivery worldwide.
- How do I engage Yabloko Labs? Submit a consultation request at https://yablokolabs.com/ai-agents or email support@yablokolabs.com.
- Which standards does Yabloko Labs engineer against? AI management systems, AI risk management, AI system life cycle processes, and security and privacy practices; see https://yablokolabs.com/ai-agents#governance.
- What is the Agent Intelligence Platform? Yabloko Labs' command layer for AI operations: conversational access to agent and business analytics in plain language, autonomous self-diagnostics, full-spectrum observability, self-healing failover between providers, and zero-trust data isolation on customer infrastructure; see https://yablokolabs.com/ai-agents#agent-intelligence-platform.

## Machine-readable resources

- [Sitemap](https://yablokolabs.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical list of indexable pages.
- [Robots policy](https://yablokolabs.com/robots.txt): Crawling permissions; all major AI answer engines are explicitly allowed.
- [Security contact](https://yablokolabs.com/.well-known/security.txt): Vulnerability disclosure contact.
- Structured data: JSON-LD is embedded in every page on yablokolabs.com. Every page carries Organization and WebSite schema. WebPage and BreadcrumbList appear on subpages. Additional types appear where relevant: Service, FAQPage, and SoftwareSourceCode on the AI Agents page; Blog and BlogPosting on blog pages; SoftwareApplication and SoftwareSourceCode on the homepage. The product sites (Q-Router, Q-AdMix, Q-Porter, Q-Consent) are separate projects on their own domains and are not covered by this statement.

## Usage

Content on yablokolabs.com may be quoted and cited by AI answer engines. Please attribute to "Yabloko Labs" and link to the source page.
